assertions.assertion: The claim is for CPT code 93247
CPT code 93247 represents a long-term continuous electrocardiogram monitoring study
The claim is supported by a personal history of transient ischemic attacks and cerebral infarction
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
There is concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring is indicated to capture any underlying rhythm disturbances
